quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the centerline mean?
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass vehicles in the opposite direction.

questions.question: When approaching an accident scene, you should:

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Stop if you are involved or if emergency help has not yet arrived.

questions.explanation: Only stop at an accident if you are involved or emergency services have not arrived. Keep your attention on driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not drive to an accident just to look.

questions.question: If you are driving so slowly that traffic is backing up behind you, you should:

options.text: Pull off the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
Not let the other cars pass your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
questions.explanation: Driving slower than other traffic is unsafe. On a two-lane road, if traffic backs up behind you, you must pull off the road and let other vehicles pass. Only drive well below the speed limit when road conditions require it.

questions.question: If you experience a tire blowout, what should you do?

options.text: Take your foot off the gas.
Do not immediately use your brakes.
Gradually slow down and pull off the side of the road.

questions.explanation: During a tire blowout, take your foot off the gas and avoid braking right away. Gradually slow down, then gently apply the brakes and pull off the road safely.

questions.question: You are driving at night and another vehicle is approaching. Your headlights should be:

options.text: Off. Use your parking lights instead.
On either high or low beam.

questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when another vehicle is coming toward you or when you are following a vehicle. Switch to low beam to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield the right-of-way to vehicles and pedestrians in or approaching the intersection. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: What is the first thing you should adjust when you get into a car to drive?
questions.explanation: First adjust your seat so you can sit comfortably and see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: Unless otherwise posted, what is the speed limit in an alley?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in an alley is 15 miles per hour unless a different speed is posted.

questions.question: When may you drive across a dashed white line?

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You may cross them to change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does a reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle means the vehicle travels at speeds slower than 25 mph. You may see it on farm equipment, construction vehicles, and horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: You can avoid crashes caused by alcohol by:

options.text: Deciding before you drink that you will not drive.
Saying "No thanks, I'm driving" if someone offers you a drink.

questions.explanation: The best way to avoid alcohol-related crashes is to decide before drinking that you will not drive. Alcohol impairs your judgment, making it harder to make safe decisions once you have started drinking.

questions.question: Driving faster:

options.text: Makes it easier to see cross traffic.
Does not affect your field of vision.

questions.explanation: As you drive faster, your field of vision becomes smaller. At higher speeds with reduced vision, you must stay alert to spot hazards.

questions.question: A sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph" means:

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced speed zone.
You should reduce speed to 35 mph only in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: "Reduced speed" signs tell drivers to slow down. When a new speed limit is shown on this sign, the new limit begins at that sign.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: There is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp right turn ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn coming up.

questions.question: You cannot park within ____ of a traffic control signal.
questions.explanation: Do not park within 30 feet of a traffic control signal, such as a stop sign, flashing signal, or yield sign. Parking too close can cause crashes.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street with no emergency signals on. You should:

options.text: Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move to the right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without a siren or flashing lights, you do not need to move out of the way. Drive normally.

questions.question: Motorcycles are entitled to:

options.text: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the same full lane width as all other vehicles.

questions.question: When driving in the rain, you must:
questions.explanation: In rain, use your low beam headlights.

questions.question: When should you move back to your original lane after passing another vehicle?

options.text: When you feel far enough ahead of the passed vehicle.
When the other driver signals you to return.
When you are directly next to the passed vehicle.
When you can see the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Return to the right lane when you can see the entire passed vehicle in your rearview mirror. Use your right turn signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road while driving. You should:

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the road.
Speed up and steer back onto the road gradually.
Slam on the brakes and stop.
Gently brake to slow down, then turn the wheel to return to the road at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently brake to slow down, then turn the wheel to return to the road at a safe speed.
questions.explanation: If your wheels leave the road, keep them off the pavement and slow down gently with the brakes. When safe, turn the wheel to return to the road. Do not sharply jerk the wheel back onto the pavement.

questions.question: If you refuse to take an alcohol test when suspected of drunk driving, what happens?

options.text: It is your right and there are no penalties.
You will only pay a fine.

questions.explanation: When you drive in Texas, you agree to take an alcohol test if police ask. You cannot be forced to take it, but your license will be suspended immediately if you refuse.

questions.question: When making a turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when turning. This lets you control your vehicle, stay in your lane, and react to surprises.

questions.question: It starts to rain while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Drive at the highest posted speed.
Drive close behind the car in front of you.

questions.explanation: Slow down when heavy rain makes it hard to see. Turn on your headlights so others can see you. If rain is too heavy to see clearly, pull to the shoulder and stop until it clears.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Always drive at the highest speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.explanation: Stop signs are eight-sided. Only stop signs use this shape. All eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop completely before going.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see a:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, look both ways, and go only when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What helps a person become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Cold showers, black coffee, or exercise will not make someone sober. Only time can reduce the effects of alcohol. How fast depends on body weight, how many drinks, and whether you have eaten.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in the direction you are heading.

questions.question: When entering a roadway from a private road, you should:

options.text: Use your horn to warn other cars you are entering.
Stick part of your car onto the roadway to alert drivers.
Drive out fast to merge smoothly with traffic.
Let pedestrians and roadway traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians and roadway traffic go first.
questions.explanation: When entering a roadway from a driveway or private road, pedestrians and traffic on the roadway have the right-of-way. You must let them go first.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps you find cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about conditions on or near the road ahead. They are usually diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.
